title: Etale descent of finite functorial log blowup procedures
statement: Consider quasi-compact locally Noetherian fs log schemes [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-trf-fs-log-blowup] with torsion-free characteristic group completions. Suppose a rule $\mathcal T$ is given on the members admitting a global fan chart [lem-trf-log-fan-chart-blowup]. It assigns a finite ordered tower of saturated log blowups with nonempty coherent log ideal centers. Assume that the assignment is independent of the chosen fan chart, and for every strict etale morphism between these members its source tower is canonically the contracted pullback of its target tower. Here pullback recursively blows up pulled-back ideals and contraction deletes only centers equal to the whole log monoid sheaf. Assume that these comparisons preserve centers and order, respect identities and composition, and that the rule is defined also on finite disjoint unions with the same compatibilities for the component inclusions. Then $\mathcal T$ extends, uniquely up to the canonical isomorphisms of contracted towers with centers, to all the indicated fs log schemes, with the same strict etale pullback compatibility. The extension is a finite saturated log blowup tower, and its centers are nonempty coherent ideals. Its contracted pullback to each chart neighborhood is the prescribed tower there.
